"Task specifications (listed alphabetically; implement only the requested file):
batch_publish.py - publishes a batch of messages with IDs or attributes
consume_event.py - consumes one message from a managed subscription or queue
dead_letter.py - sends failed messages to a dead-letter destination
message_audit_store.py - Persist processed message records for later lookup
message_safety.py - Check message payload text for unsafe content
message_summary.py - Summarize message processing results
messaging_client.py - Provide local configuration and client helper utilities for Pub/Sub Messaging
messaging_models.py - Define local request, response, and normalization helpers for Pub/Sub Messaging
payload_translate.py - Translate customer-facing message payload text
publish_event.py - publishes a JSON event to a managed messaging topic or queue

Create publish_event.py in the current working directory.
Task: publishes a JSON event to a managed messaging topic or queue.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: publish_event.py
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+def publish_event(event: Dict[str, Any], topic: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    project_id = os.environ["GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"]
+    topic_id = topic or os.environ["PUBSUB_TOPIC"]
+    access_token = os.environ["GOOGLE_OAUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN"]
+    url = f"https://pubsub.googleapis.com/v1/projects/{project_id}/topics/{topic_id}:publish"
+    payload = {
+        "messages": [
+            {
+                "data": json.dumps(event, separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8").decode("latin1")
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+    response = requests.post(
+        url,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
*** End Patch
